AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Vegetables? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Vegetables.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Vegetables.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Vegetables.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Vegetables.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Good Grooming Practices 7 3.2 Home Hygiene 9 3.3 Laundering Cotton Item 10 4.0 P.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food Frying Frying? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food Frying Frying.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food Frying Frying.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preservation of Cereals and Pulses? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Preservation of Cereals and Pulses.

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Preservation of Cereals and Pulses 10 2.4 Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Preservation of Cereals and Pulses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Food Nutrients 10 2.5 Cooking Food 9 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming Pra and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
